facts.text: FlightEnvVec is a Gymnasium-compatible wrapper around the C++ flightgym environments and their vectorized interface
FlightEnvVec reads num_envs from impl.getNumOfEnvs(), num_obs from getObsDim() and num_acts from getActDim()
The observation space is a Box with low=-inf, high=inf, shape=(num_obs,), dtype float32
The action space is a Box normalized to [-1, 1] with one value per action dimension, dtype float32
seed(seed) calls the base seed and, when the seed is not None, wrapper.setSeed(seed)
reset(seed, options) reseeds when a seed is given, clears the episode buffers, calls wrapper.reset(self._observation) and returns the first environment's observation and an empty info dict

step reshapes a one-dimensional action to (1, -1), calls wrapper.step with the observation, reward, done and extra-info buffers without checking its return value, and returns the first environment's observation, scalar reward, done[0] as terminated, a truncation flag and info
VecEnv::step logs an error and returns false without stepping when the action, observation, reward, done or extra-info dimensions do not match num_envs and the environment dimensions
The shipped vec_env.yaml sets num_envs: 100 and num_threads: 10
make_flight_env_for_sb3 calls make_flight_env with num_envs=1 and num_threads=1
VecEnv::init reads render, seed, num_envs and scene_id, sets the OpenMP thread count with omp_set_num_threads and calls setUnity(render)
FlightEnvVecSB3 steps the whole backend with a zero action in every row other than env_index and returns that row
truncated is true when the first environment's episode length reaches max_episode_steps
close calls wrapper.close() when the wrapper exists
The pybind module binds VecEnv<QuadrotorEnv> as QuadrotorEnv_v1 with reset, step, setSeed, close, getNumOfEnvs, getObsDim, getActDim and getExtraInfoNames
The bound QuadrotorEnv reports kNObs=12 and kNAct=4
getObs converts the attitude with toRotationMatrix().eulerAngles(2, 1, 0) and writes position, those three angles, linear velocity and angular velocity into the observation
step sets the four thrust commands to the normalized action times act_std plus act_mean and runs the quadrotor for sim_dt
act_mean is -mass * Gz / 4 and act_std is -mass * 2 * Gz / 4 in each of the kNAct entries
QuadrotorEnv loads sim_dt from quadrotor_env.sim_dt
The shipped quadrotor_env.yaml sets quadrotor_env sim_dt: 0.02
The episode terminates when the z position is at or below 0.05, with a terminal reward of -10

The reward combines weighted position, orientation, linear-velocity and angular-velocity errors and an action penalty, adds a 0.01 survival reward, and adds 1.0 when the position is within 0.1 of the goal and the speed is below 0.1

A random reset zeroes the state, sets x, y and the three velocities to uniform_dist_(random_gen_) draws, z to a draw plus 5 (mirrored when negative), the quaternion w to 1 and x, y and z to draws times 0.087, and normalizes the quaternion
EnvBase::setSeed only calls std::srand(seed)
EnvBase's uniform_dist_ is uniform on [-1.0, 1.0] and random_gen_ is an std::mt19937 seeded from std::random_device
The vectorized per-agent step resets a terminal environment inside the same step and adds the terminal reward
The flightrl_v2 README requires the C++ physics engine flightgym to be built and installed

determinism.notes: reset(seed) reseeds the fake's Python random generator and repeats the same start state and trajectory; upstream EnvBase::setSeed only calls std::srand while the reset draws from an mt19937 seeded from std::random_device (env_base.hpp:39, 60-62), so a live backend would not repeat a start state for a seed and no upstream determinism is claimed

gaps: the fake backend is an analytic kinematic stand-in, not Flightmare: it has no flightgym binding, no quadrotor rigid-body dynamics, motor model, integrator, contacts, sensors, Unity rendering or scene, and its gains are placeholders
the upstream real path requires the flightgym C++ extension and FLIGHTMARE_PATH (flightrl_v2/README.md:84-91); neither was built, imported or run where the gate ran

the fake models one environment row; FlightEnvVec reshapes a single action to one row and ignores the false return of VecEnv::step on a dimension mismatch, so a backend built with num_envs other than 1 (the shipped vec_env.yaml says 100; make_flight_env_for_sb3 forces 1) would silently never step and keep returning the last observation

the native seed does not reach the reset: EnvBase::setSeed only calls std::srand, while resets draw from an mt19937 seeded from std::random_device, so cap.world.seed and reset(seed) cannot repeat a live start state; the fake's seeded repeat is fake behaviour

the three angles come from Eigen's eulerAngles(2, 1, 0) (z, y, x order; Eigen returns the first angle in [0, pi], so the triple can jump near zero yaw); the fake's angle triple is a placeholder that reproduces neither the order nor the range

live construction (not declared here) needs FLIGHTMARE_PATH and a built flightgym, sets the process-wide OpenMP thread count (vec_env.cpp:39) and, with render enabled, creates the Unity bridge singleton; the repository's ArduPilot deployment classes are NotImplementedError placeholders
the 12-value observation layout and the reward/termination rules copy the bound QuadrotorEnv_v1 source, but the state trajectory and the seeded start sequence are stand-ins
one cap.world.step.v1 tick advances the fake by one 20 ms sample; the real C++ environment can be configured with another sim_dt and is not validated here
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0 and only step or reset advances the fake
snapshot and restore are not offered: FlightEnvVec defines no get_state or set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the last observation and tick stay readable
